title: Cristalline
identity: Gilles Martin, Cristalline (1999), pedagogical single-movement work for E-flat alto saxophone and piano, Billaudot G6488B. Composer’s catalogue provides movement character, range, audience context, and recording credit.

evidence.claim: Composer’s catalogue identifies Cristalline, Billaudot G6488B, 1999, alto sax and piano, approx. 1:40, with expressive Andante, varied articulation, delicate phrasing, and written range to F-sharp high with ossia; gives institutional pedagogical placement and recording credit.
Composer states the work is one movement, Andante, about 1:40, dedicated to Jean-Yves Fourmeau; description includes varied articulation and delicate phrasing.

review_focus: Inference from the composer’s documented expressive Andante and varied articulations: review tone continuity, phrasing, and contrast among articulations. No level is proposed.
collection_flag: Documented pedagogical piece for early French conservatory cycle and saxophone exam/contest use. This describes the published work’s original audience context.

listening.description: Composer credits a recording by Christian Wirth, saxophone, and Gilles Martin, piano, on Confidences (1999).
listening.verification: Recording credit verified on opened composer page; not auditioned.
